contentText: Iran's army chief Amir Hatami said on Wednesday that his country will retaliate in a “more devastating” manner if the United States and its allies launch new attacks on its territory. Earlier that day, Iran's official IRNA news agency reported that Washington had hit Qeshm Island without causing serious damage, while Kuwait and Bahrain said that they intercepted hostile strikes.  Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
